svg.title: Same method, different curvature
svg.desc: Side-by-side coframe, connection, and curvature formulas compare the polar plane with the sphere. These are local formulas on regular angular charts. The polar origin and sphere poles need other frames; a singular coordinate expression there is not an extra curvature singularity.

g.text: A coframe converts coordinate changes into ruler readings.
A nonzero connection occurs in both. A nonzero curvature two-form distinguishes the sphere.
